children: Canada women's fashion retailer's fiscal Q2 revenue grew 29.8%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company raised fiscal 2026 guidance for comparable store sales, revenue and adjusted EBITDA margin
Groupe Dynamite raises fiscal 2026 comparable store sales growth guidance to 12%-14%
Company now expects fiscal 2026 total revenue growth of 25%-27%
Groupe Dynamite sees fiscal 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin at 39.5%-40.5%
SALES GROWTH DRIVERS - Co said revenue growth was driven by a 10.3% rise in comparable store sales and contributions from new stores
GROSS MARGIN EXPANSION - Gross margin rose due to lower tariffs, controlled merchandise cost increases and lower logistics costs
INVENTORY MANAGEMENT - Improved inventory turnover and agile product development contributed to results
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 13 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for GROUPE DYNAMITE INC. is C$90.00, about 58.3% above its September 9 closing price of C$56.87
